audit_cycle: fresh-independent-2026-06-15 (4 parallel deep-readers + manual core-loop read; corroborates and extends the 2026-06-10..06-13 cycles)
reference_paths: d:\tmp (supporting context only; not assumed production)
threat_model: Single trusted operator, full host access, no sandbox / no path fence by design (amendment #50 / D-15c). Findings graded within that model AND the multi-channel serve-daemon deployment reality.

score_basis.rationale: Verified-correct reasoning loop (bounded recovery, non-empty terminal contract, cache discipline, SSRF hardening, nonce trust envelope, ~19.4k test LOC) held down by perimeter gaps: panic isolation, MCP resilience, hook safety, observability, secret hygiene, crash-resume.

p0_findings.title: Unrecovered panics in spawned goroutines crash the entire daemon
p0_findings.evidence: Repo-wide grep: only recover() in production internal/ is db/tx.go:28. No panic recovery in any agent/swarm goroutine.
p0_findings.impact: One panicking tool/child terminates aura serve for all channels/users (system-wide failure).

p1_findings.title: Hook exec TOCTOU + full os.Environ() secrets + unvalidated request rewrite
Failing/slow hook aborts the whole turn (no fail-soft)
MCP reconnect: lock-during-IO, ctx-coupled, no backoff/breaker
AURA_MCP_CALL_TIMEOUT_SEC=0 disables per-call timeout -> hang + held mutex
No capability gate on mutating MCP tools; reconnect flips Mutating
Reasoning-router LLM fallback adds <=8s extra round-trip/turn on sidecar degrade
Full prompts/history/PII logged to reasoning trace; redaction name-only
DB password leaks into shell_exec children via DSN-shaped env vars
Skill self-activation ungated despite gated-looking spec (prior B-04)
No latency/error/cost/outcome metrics -> no SLOs (prior O-02)
No structured logs; tracing silent-drop + mintSpanID panic (prior O-01)

top_10_risks: AG-001 — daemon-wide crash from one panicking tool (P0)
AG-005 — MCP reconnect livelock / head-of-line freeze (P1)
AG-007 — no capability gate on mutating MCP tools (P1)
AG-010 — DB password leaks to shell children (P1)
AG-011 — ungated skill self-activation / injection persistence (P1)
AG-052 — swarm/unknown-tool output not enveloped -> indirect injection (P1 in deployment)
recommended_next_actions: Add recover() to every spawned goroutine (executeBatch, parallel.runSub, swarm.runWave, shell_bg) + Runner backstop — translate panics to per-call/per-child errors (AG-001).
Add a sync.Mutex to dedupRing to remove the latent concurrent-map-write fatal recover() cannot catch (AG-002).

Harden MCP reconnect: single-flight off-lock, context.WithoutCancel + dedicated timeout, exponential backoff + circuit breaker; treat AURA_MCP_CALL_TIMEOUT_SEC=0 as default and validate at boot (AG-005/AG-006).
Close the secret boundary: DSN markers in IsSecretEnvKey; stop inheriting os.Environ() into command hooks (AG-010/AG-003).
Add observability minimum: slog at turn/LLM/tool boundaries + Prometheus turn_total{outcome}/llm_call_duration/*_errors_total/token counters; never panic in mintSpanID (AG-012/AG-013).
strengths_no_action: SSRF hardening in internal/web (pinned-IP dial, scheme allowlist, metadata-IP block, per-hop redirect re-validation, size cap)
KV-cache stable-prefix discipline (byte-stable messages[0], tail-injected volatile hints)
Shared-atomic budget defeating the max_steps^depth swarm fan-out bomb
Non-empty terminal contract (text_response -> forced synthesis -> deterministic Italian stub)
Bounded recovery/completion/truncation counters (no unbounded continue; 203-turn thrash closed)
Test investment: 105 test files / ~19.4k test LOC, goleak-guarded TestMain, property + fuzz tests
